notes: Recorded 331 bachelor rows (includes general medicine programmes), 237 master rows (includes medical residency programmes) and 193 doctoral rows: one row per level, institution and programme, with the languages of instruction merged into the detail. The annex table has 1,360 level/institution/programme/language lines, all read (line counts checked page by page against the document). The source does not state a total.
The annex tables are the 2026-2027 call. The same programme often appears once per language of instruction (Azerbaijani, English, Russian, Turkish); the detail field lists them.

Programme names keep the source's wording, including its own spelling variants (for example 'Environmental Engeenering'). One doctoral name given only in Azerbaijani in the Azerbaijani-language table was recorded under its English name from the English-language table.

The annex was read in the copy published by Rwanda's Higher Education Council because the file on the Azerbaijani study portal contains only the main text of the call; the Rwanda copy carries different application dates in the timeline (May 18 to June 1 for the second stage instead of June 1 to June 10), so it may be an earlier version of the call; levels, ages, benefits and the annex structure agree, but editors should treat the programme tables as the version attached to that copy. Preparatory-course availability per programme is given in the detail.
The 'diploma' level (preparatory courses) has no programme list in the annex.
